A0156.title: On-Chain Reputation and Credit Systems
A0156.definition: A trust scoring mechanism built on on-chain behavioral data, serving as an alternative to traditional KYC identity verification.
A0156.description: Reputation system: on-chain transaction history; smart contract interactions; DeFi credit score; social graph; Sybil resistance; soulbound tokens.
A0156.limitation: Historical data may be insufficient, manipulation risk is high, privacy is prone to leakage, and standards are not unified. Attackers can farm accounts at scale through Sybil attacks, forge interaction records to inflate on-chain reputation scores and bypass credit checks. New users with sparse activity are easily misclassified as high risk, leading to both evasion and false positive issues.
